meaning: The panel requires a per-patient M4 run at that patient's own boundary conditions, and refuses the generic m4/jugular_compression run as a fallback. The comment records a past bug where the M4 column ran to t_end=160.0 (ends_early=True) while patient columns ran to 418.37 and 418.75 s, so the comparison mixed a Pext ramp with a patient creneau.
expectation: If per-patient M4 runs are missing, the M4 column is simply absent rather than wrong; figures lose columns instead of gaining a stimulus mismatch. Size unknown from the context.

could_move.what: The per-patient lookup latest_run("m4", experiment, cls + "_p" + p) returning None for some patient silently drops that M4 column, so panel content depends on which runs exist on disk.
found_any is initialised per patient but the context does not show how it is used, so the no-run-found branch and any warning behaviour cannot be checked here.
The quoted numbers (160.0, 418.37, 418.75) are a frozen record of an earlier bug; if the decks or stimulus durations have changed the comment may now be stale.

check.why: Re-runs only the export/plot step and shows which patients found an M4 run and which columns were dropped, without refitting.
